birth-weekday.kicker: the vara desk · seven days · one graha each
hook: seven days, seven grahas. this is the one placement u already know.
birth-weekday.sub: vara: the weekday lord. real jyotish, and no chart needed to find urs.

cards.line: cannot be in a room without ending up in charge of it
cards.sub: surya does not do side quests and it does not do anonymous. the day wants credit, and it has usually earned it.

cards.line: mood is a weather system and everyone else lives downwind
cards.sub: chandra changes sign every two and a half days. so do u, and u have quietly decided that is everyone else's problem.

cards.line: sent it. read it back. sent another one.
cards.sub: mangal does not let a draft cool down. it is the speed that wins the argument and the speed that pays for it later.

cards.line: has argued both sides. in the same conversation. convincingly.
cards.sub: budha is the negotiator. unbeatable in a meeting, exhausting in a relationship, and genuinely not sure which one it meant.

cards.line: gives advice nobody asked for and is annoyingly right
cards.sub: guru is the teacher of the chart. the trouble with a teacher is that class never actually ends.

cards.line: will not leave in the wrong outfit. will leave the country on a whim.
cards.sub: shukra wants it beautiful before it wants it sensible. a very good eye and a very expensive one.

cards.line: old since nine. tired since twelve. correct since about now.
cards.sub: shani makes u wait for every single thing and then hands it over permanently. slowest start in the week, longest run.

cta.p: not the date. the day of the week. that is the graha that has been running ur week since u got here.

rising-sign.kicker: the lagna desk · what they decide first
hook: the lagna is the door. the sun is what's behind it.
rising-sign.sub: lagna needs ur birth time. that is why nobody has ever told u urs.

cards.line: walked in like the meeting had already started
cards.sub: lagna sets the pace before u speak. this one arrives at full volume and wonders why everyone looks startled.

cards.line: looks expensive even in a hoodie
cards.sub: the door is calm and well made. people assume money. it is usually just refusal to rush.

cards.line: read the room and then rearranged it
cards.sub: a door that talks first. charming in ten minutes, exhausting in three hours, and it knows.

cards.line: gave u the good chair without being asked
cards.sub: reads the temperature on arrival. it is genuine care and it is also a way of staying in charge of the room.

cards.line: apologised for being late in a way that got applause
cards.sub: the door is a performance and it is a good one. the risk is forgetting there is a house behind it.

cards.line: noticed the thing u hoped nobody noticed
cards.sub: a door that audits. useful, precise, and quietly terrifying to live with.

cards.line: agreed with u and u still do not know their opinion
cards.sub: the smoothest door in the set. everything lands softly, including things that should not have.

cards.line: said four words and u thought about them all week
cards.sub: gives nothing away on purpose. people call it intense. it is just the shutters being closed.

cards.line: turned a small question into a plan for march
cards.sub: the door is already leaving. enormous energy, no follow through unless something holds it.

cards.line: was the only one who actually read the document
cards.sub: arrives older than they are. competent from a distance, hard to get past up close.

cards.line: disagreed with the premise, politely
cards.sub: a door that does not do small talk. it does not dislike u, it just cannot see the point of the warm up.

cards.line: made u feel understood and said almost nothing
cards.sub: the softest door and the least fixed. it takes the shape of the room, then wonders where it went.

hook: mangal is not anger. it is what u do with it.

cards.line: does not draft. sends.
cards.sub: mangal here has no gap between feeling it and doing it. wins the exchange, loses the week.

cards.line: goes quiet for eleven days then brings receipts
cards.sub: slow to start, impossible to stop. the fight is over. this chart is still holding it.

cards.line: wins on technicality and calls it a draw
cards.sub: argues to be correct, not to be finished. will use ur own sentence against u.

cards.line: says 'it's fine' and it is famously not fine
cards.sub: conflict goes sideways here, never forward. the hurt arrives before the argument does.

cards.line: needs an audience or it is not worth having
cards.sub: the fight is about dignity, not the topic. apologise in public and it is over in seconds.

cards.line: corrects ur grammar mid argument
cards.sub: mangal filed under precision. fatal in a debate, unbearable in a kitchen.

cards.line: refuses to fight and wins by exhaustion
cards.sub: conflict is avoided until it leaks. the nicest people here have the longest lists.

cards.line: does not argue. remembers.
cards.sub: nothing is raised in the moment. everything is filed, and the file does not expire.

cards.line: escalates to philosophy in under a minute
cards.sub: the specific complaint becomes a statement about society. u came about the dishes.

cards.line: waits for u to be wrong in writing
cards.sub: mangal with paperwork. will not engage until the position is unassailable.

cards.line: argues the principle while u argue the thing
cards.sub: cold, fair and completely beside the point u were making.

cards.line: cries and then comforts u about it
cards.sub: conflict dissolves rather than resolves. u will leave feeling like the villain either way.
